summary: Exam Register Column Linkage Feature - CORRECTED Implementation. All 14 backend tests passed, all frontend UI elements verified. Changed from two fields (register_type + register_participation) to single mutually exclusive field (register_column).

Each period has id, nombre, orden fields
GET /api/exams/register-availability returns 200 OK
Availability returns all 5 slots: EM, EB, P1, P2, P3
Each slot has 'available' boolean and 'assigned_exam' field

POST /api/course/{subject_id}/exams with register_column=EM creates exam correctly
POST /api/course/{subject_id}/exams with register_column=P1 creates exam (mutually exclusive)
POST /api/course/{subject_id}/exams with register_column=null creates exam without linkage

POST with invalid register_column returns 400
POST with register_column but no period_id returns 400
DELETE /api/exams/{id} frees the slot

Frontend: All slots show 'Disponible' badges when available

context_for_next_testing_agent: Exam register_column linkage feature complete. CORRECTED from previous implementation (iteration_85) which used two fields. Backend endpoints: GET /api/academic/periods, GET /api/exams/register-availability, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/course/{subject_id}/exams with register_column field.
